cite.text: VSEE HEALTH, INC. · S-1 filed Oct 1, 2026 · Six months ended Jun 30, 2026

analysis: Revenue was $3.4M in H1 2026, up 53% year over year.

Gross margin was 27.1%, down 36.1 points from H1 2025. Operating costs exceeded revenue by $4.4M, an operating margin of -126.6%. Operating expenses grew 17% against revenue growth of 53%. The fastest-growing cost line was General & admin (+22%). The period ended with a net loss of $1.8M. Non-operating items added $2.6M, -149% of pre-tax earnings, so the bottom line overstates operating performance.
Operating cash flow was −$3.6M. Non-cash charges added back $1.3M of depreciation and amortization and $644K of share-based compensation. Working capital and other items used $3.8M.

analysis: Revenue was $14.6M in FY 2025, up 40% year over year.
